desktop.notesZh:
批次十六（splash 版本号与慢启动提示位 + 确认门流程图分支判定块 + 门禁正文分段与小节化明细）
① splash：版本号从左下角移至面板左上角；停留超过 5 秒左下角一行内联浮出「首次启动耗时较久，请耐心等待」与「后台启动」按钮。② 确认门流程图新增需求进入判定块：工作区未初始化·先行（串行前置）→ 按进行中变更数三选一（互斥：无进行中的变更/已有一条进行中的变更/多条未完成的变更，条件芯片 + 虚线汇流轨）→ 分类确认汇合后进入接单；接续/绑定分支以虚线回边表达不再汇入分类。③ 确认门正文全表面分段：门禁明细卡片、确认门弹窗、工作流顶部弹窗统一按【…】小节渲染（小节标题 + 段落/列表），{{change:}} 标记剥离不再外显。④ 门禁明细改版：阶段门禁/进入下一步的条件/确认门标题升级为醒目小节 chip（品牌蓝点 + 确认门警示色）；进入下一步的条件改为复选框样式清单，替换原先突兀的行内代码样式。⑤ 确认门节点（药丸）可点击：hover/选中环/aria-pressed 完整按钮语义，点击在明细面板打开该确认门专属详情（确认门徽标 + 正文分段卡）；状态节点卡片不再内嵌确认门内容，仅保留阶段说明、进入条件与「确认门 ×N · 点击确认门节点查看」提示——确认门在状态切换间触发，详情归属确认门节点。
desktop.notesEn:
Batch sixteen (splash version position + slow-start hint row + gates flowchart decision block + segmented gate bodies and sectioned details)
(1) Splash: the version label moves from bottom-left to the panel top-left; after 5s a single bottom-left row appears with the slow-start hint and the Start-in-background button. (2) The gates flowchart gains a request-entry decision block: workspace-uninitialized runs first (sequential pre-row), then an exclusive three-way pick by active-change count (none / one / many, condition chips joined by a dashed rail) converging on the classify gate before 接单; the resume/bind branches return as dashed re-entry edges and bypass classification. (3) Gate bodies are segmented on every surface: the details card, the gate dialog, and the workflow-top banner all render 【…】 sections (titles + paragraphs/lists) with the {{change:}} marker peeled. (4) Details redesign: the stage-gate / next-step conditions / confirm-gate titles become prominent section chips (brand dot, warning tint for confirm gates); next-step conditions render as a checkbox-style checklist replacing the jarring inline-code styling. (5) Gate pills are clickable buttons (hover ring, selected ring, aria-pressed) that open that gate’s own detail (confirm-gate badge + segmented body); state node cards no longer embed gate content — stage description, entry conditions, and a confirm-gate count hint remain, because gates fire between states.
